title: Vatican dossier and joint SS-Italian study of the Magenta object in a third country

tellings.quote: Vatican was informed of it and has a dossier on it and the Vatican was involved in the sort of study of this uh object um in a joint working group that involved both SS scientists and uh Italian scientists in a third party country.

plain: In the 1930s, the Vatican was told about a mysterious craft known in this lore as the Magenta object, kept a file on it, and took part in a joint working group of Nazi SS scientists and Italian scientists who studied it in a third country, which the story places in Czechoslovakia. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this to Michels without a named source, though he cites a witness named David Grusch. If true, the Church and two fascist states were studying a strange object together years before the American UFO era began.
